five_axes.correctness: Format1 uses the same complete read_owned_field and fixed predicate executor as format0. The first planned failure still loses to any later structural failure. Primitive codec offsets and widths are bounded by the original field; i32/u32 and signed/unsigned 64-bit representations remain exact.
five_axes.identity_and_ownership: Native selection binds exact current configuration, captured revision, entry graph mode and checkpoint. The JS header checks count/checkpoint/mode and every dynamic original index/value count. Only a successful native result plus full shape/type validation registers format1 proof. Public raw and primitive constructors cannot mint proof. Both format tags and replay/graph/kind identity are required.
five_axes.failure_boundaries: Only absent provider or statically unsupported geometry returns null. Native undefined/error executes NativeReadFailure and cannot return fallback null. Neither source factory nor canonical scope decoder catches failures to manufacture a verified projection. Scope unsupported blocks retain full strict fallback; codec metadata is emitted only when the new helper exists.
five_axes.single_business_owner: Raw primitives, DataView and pointer acquisition feed one decodeCapturedScopeField. Clock, integer expected values, className admissibility, semantic phase/round/state outputs, autoScope continuity and collection-mode policy remain JavaScript. Four class fields retain original role/checkpoint finally context. No cross-record fact cache or new Game read is added.
five_axes.validation_scope: Read-only final five-commit combination review. Previously recorded 110 targeted functional PASS and provider-owned CPP/Node signed/index/brand/error tests were reused; no repeated heavy test or DLL compilation in this review. Source simulator is explicitly not represented as real native issuance evidence.

boundaries: Not a throughput, no-overflow, infinite-stability or game-FPS acceptance.
